animations.carried: sneaky walk while carried: tiptoes in the air and glances side to side, in on the heist, never struggling
animations.denIdle: happy idle in the den: its tails cycle through the phases of the moon one by one

name: Lunar Kitsune
pose: standing on all four short legs like an animal, not upright like a person
